LIBTPU_RS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install libtpu-rs. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

LIBTPU_RS_VERSION.description: Specific version of libtpu-rs to install.

LIBTPU_RS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading libtpu-rs binary or archive artifacts.

LIBTPU_RS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying libtpu-rs available remote releases.

LIBTPU_RS_REPO_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the libtpu-rs workspace repository.

LIBTPU_RS_GIT_URL.description: Optional Git URL cloned when LIBTPU_RS_REPO_DIR is not already present on disk.

LIBTPU_RS_PAPER_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the libtpu_paper manuscript directory.

LIBTPU_RS_RESULTS_DIR.description: Directory where mechanical E0-E7 JSON artifacts and generated_metrics.tex are emitted.

LIBTPU_RS_CARGO_PROFILE.description: Pinned Cargo release profile identifier enforced under SIGPLAN RULE-6.

LIBTPU_RS_SLIM_FEATURES.description: Cargo feature flags passed when building the slim shared library variant without embedded reflection/CSR catalogs.

LIBTPU_RS_JAX_VERSION.description: Upstream jax and jaxlib version installed into the isolated component virtual environment for Suite E3.

LIBTPU_RS_WARMUP.description: Number of unrecorded warmup runs executed prior to recorded trials.

LIBTPU_RS_TRIALS.description: Number of recorded fresh trials executed per benchmark cell.

LIBTPU_RS_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of libtpu_paper empirical sub-suites to execute.

LIBTPU_RS_BUILD_PDF.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling full pdflatex + bibtex compilation and Overfull/Type-3 PK log verification in Suite E8.

LIBTPU_RS_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES.description: Internal CI test flag (0 or 1) enabling deterministic synthetic repository/manuscript fixtures for smoke testing without hardware or external repos.

LIBTPU_RS_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) logging planned benchmark actions and verifying prerequisites without executing heavy workloads.

LIBTPU_RS_HOST_ARCH.description: Canonical OS/ISA identifier ('linux_x64', 'macos_arm64', or 'windows_x64') tagged onto per-host benchmark artifacts.

LIBTPU_RS_ALLOW_DIRTY.description: Flag (0 or 1) permitting exploratory local development runs on dirty git worktrees prior to final RULE-1 locking.
